traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The giant can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant makes two Lightning Sword attacks or uses Wind Javelin twice.

actions.name: Lightning Sword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 40 (9d6+9) lightning damage.

actions.name: Windjavelin
actions.text: The giant coalesces wind into a javeIin-like form and hurls it at a creature it can see within 600 feet of it. The javelin is considered a magic weapon and deals 19 (3d6+9) piercing damage to the target, striking unerringly. The javelin disappears after it hits.
